tiers.text: What does the profile say the loop is spending its time on? Which call is made the most times?
The loop visits every unique pair: N(N-1)/2 of them. Count them for N = 1000.
499,500 pairs, and so 499,500 sqrt calls. The fit's exponent is about 2, so the time at 200,000 is (200000/2000)^2 x t(2000). Divide seconds by 60 for minutes.
The gate unlock answer is 499500: the reference compares every pair once, N(N-1)/2 = 1000 x 999 / 2.
